w=param("dino_width",48)
h=param("dino_height",58)
t=param("dino_thickness",13)
edge=param("dino_edge_radius",2)
gap=param("dino_foot_gap",12)
fh=param("dino_foot_gap_height",9)
tw=param("tail_reach",17)
tr=param("tail_root_radius",5.6)
rise=param("tail_tip_height",10.5)
fr=param("foot_gap_rounding",1.2)
dip=param("tail_mid_dip",1.3)
tip_r=param("tail_tip_round_radius",1.1)
fullness=param("dino_head_fullness",1.2)
crown_rise=param("dino_crown_rise",22)
backing_w=param("muzzle_backing_width",51)
backing_h=param("muzzle_backing_height",32.714)
backing_x=param("muzzle_backing_center_x",-8.5)
backing_z=param("muzzle_backing_center_z",22.857)
shoulder_inset=param("muzzle_side_shoulder_inset",1.5)
head_cz=h-crown_rise
left_cheek_fullness=param("dino_own_left_cheek_fullness",3.8)
insert=param("dino_foot_insert_depth",4)
seat_top_local=param("dino_seat_top_local_z",2)
bottom_z=seat_top_local-insert
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            cx=-w/48
            r=w/2+fullness
            left_x=backing_x-backing_w/2
            # Hard leg-root corner; tangent cheek-to-crown junction.
            Bezier((-w*.36,fh),((-w*.36+left_x)/2,fh+edge),(left_x,backing_z-backing_h*.32),(left_x,backing_z))
            Bezier((left_x,backing_z),(left_x,backing_z+backing_h*.32),(cx-r+shoulder_inset,head_cz-7),(cx-r+shoulder_inset,head_cz))
            # Rational quarter curves form one tangent- and curvature-continuous oval crown.
            Bezier((cx-r+shoulder_inset,head_cz),(cx-r+shoulder_inset,h),(cx,h),weights=[1,2**-.5,1])
            # A continuous outward-convex cheek restores a rounded, full silhouette.
            Bezier((cx,h),(cx+r+left_cheek_fullness,h),(cx+r+left_cheek_fullness,fh+(head_cz-fh)*.75),(w*.43,fh))
            Polyline((w*.43,fh),(w*.43,bottom_z),(-w*.36,bottom_z),(-w*.36,fh))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=t)
    fillet([e for e in bp.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y,reverse=True) if e.bounding_box().min.Z>bottom_z+1e-5],edge)
with BuildPart() as opening:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with Locations(((w*.43-w*.36)/2,(fh+bottom_z-1)/2)):
            RectangleRounded(gap,fh-bottom_z+1,fr)
    extrude(amount=t+2,both=True)
body=bp.part-opening.part
foot_left=-w*.36
foot_right=w*.43
foot_mid=(foot_left+foot_right)/2
left_foot_width=foot_mid-gap/2-foot_left
right_foot_width=foot_right-(foot_mid+gap/2)
assert abs(left_foot_width-right_foot_width)<1e-8
print("Foot gap:",gap,"mm; both foot widths:",left_foot_width,"mm")
# Tail keeps its length, dips gently and closes with an integrated round cap.
from math import sqrt
root_x=w*.37
tip_x=w/2+tw
cap_x=tip_x-tip_r
root_z=tr
low_z=root_z-dip
with BuildPart() as tail:
    stations=[
        (root_x,tr,root_z),
        (root_x+(cap_x-root_x)*.15,tr*.90,root_z-dip*.55),
        (root_x+(cap_x-root_x)*.35,tr*.74,low_z),
        (root_x+(cap_x-root_x)*.55,tr*.57,low_z+(rise-low_z)*.12),
        (root_x+(cap_x-root_x)*.75,tr*.44,low_z+(rise-low_z)*.42),
        (root_x+(cap_x-root_x)*.90,tr*.34,low_z+(rise-low_z)*.83),
        (root_x+(cap_x-root_x)*.96,tip_r*1.04,rise),
        (cap_x,tip_r,rise)]
    for xx,rr,zz in stations:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(xx)):
            with Locations((-t/2,zz)):
                Circle(rr)
    loft()
rounded_tail=tail.part+Pos(cap_x,-t/2,rise)*Sphere(tip_r)
assert len(rounded_tail.solids())==1
# Only hidden material below the seat outside the right foot is relieved.
relief=Pos((foot_right+tip_x+tip_r)/2,-t/2,seat_top_local-(tr+t)/2)*Box(tip_x+tip_r-foot_right,t+2*tr,tr+t)
rounded_tail=rounded_tail-relief
body=body+rounded_tail
assert len(body.solids())==1
body.color=srgb("#24a84e")
publish("dino",body,"恐龙主体与鼻嘴托底",material="pla")

source_snapshot.parts/horn/000-horn.py:
from math import sqrt, atan, cos, sin, pi
r=param("horn_base_radius",4.8)
h=param("horn_height",15)
tip_r=param("horn_tip_round_radius",1.1)
lean=param("horn_forward_lean_deg",8)
side_lean=param("horn_side_lean_deg",5)
# A tapered cone meets its rounded cap tangentially, without a pinched neck.
zc=h-tip_r
slope=(r*zc-tip_r*sqrt(zc*zc+r*r-tip_r*tip_r))/(zc*zc-tip_r*tip_r)
angle=atan(slope)
tx=tip_r*cos(angle)
tz=zc+tip_r*sin(angle)
mid_angle=(angle+pi/2)/2
with BuildPart() as hp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline((0,0),(r,0),(tx,tz))
            ThreePointArc((tx,tz),(tip_r*cos(mid_angle),zc+tip_r*sin(mid_angle)),(0,h))
            Line((0,h),(0,0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)
horn=Rot(lean,-side_lean,0)*hp.part
assert len(horn.solids())==1
horn.color=srgb("#fff0d3")
publish("horn",horn,"参考图圆头锥形独角",material="pla")
fit("horn","dino",kind="fused",reason="参考图圆头锥形独角根部接入头顶，略向正前方倾斜")

h=param("leg_height",31)
radius=param("leg_radius",5.2)
top_radius=param("leg_top_radius",4.2)
sx=param("leg_top_spacing_x",54)
sy=param("leg_top_spacing_y",39)
splay=param("leg_splay",5)
end_round=param("leg_end_rounding",3)
pw=param("leg_plate_width",64)
pd=param("leg_plate_depth",49)
pt=param("leg_plate_thickness",2.2)
pr=param("leg_plate_rounding",3)
embed=param("leg_plate_leg_overlap",1)
with BuildPart() as plate:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(h-embed)):
        RectangleRounded(pw,pd,pr)
    extrude(amount=pt)
base=plate.part
for a,b in [(-1,-1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(1,1)]:
    with BuildPart() as leg:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
            with Locations((a*(sx/2+splay),b*(sy/2+splay))):
                Circle(radius)
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(h)):
            with Locations((a*sx/2,b*sy/2)):
                Circle(top_radius)
        loft()
        fillet(leg.edges(),end_round)
    base=base+leg.part
assert radius>top_radius
assert len(base.solids())==1
print("Leg lower/top diameters:",radius*2,top_radius*2,"mm; joining plate:",pw,pd,pt,"mm")
base.color=srgb("#251510")
publish("leg_base",base,"四腿与嵌入薄板",material="pla")
fit("leg_base","seat",kind="fused",reason="四条腿先一体连接薄板，薄板嵌入座面底部，顶部0.2mm接入座面")

w=param("muzzle_width",47)
h=param("muzzle_height",27)
d=param("muzzle_depth",17)
nr=param("nostril_radius",0.9)
spacing=param("nostril_spacing",6)
vertical_bulge=param("muzzle_vertical_bulge",1.4)
front_bulge=param("muzzle_front_bulge",2.5)
full_h=h+2*vertical_bulge
full_d=d+front_bulge
centre_y=-full_d/2
with BuildPart() as mp:
    for fraction,scale in [(-.5,.02),(-.35,.79),(0,1),(.35,.79),(.5,.02)]:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(w*fraction)):
            with Locations((centre_y,0)):
                Ellipse(full_d/2*scale,full_h/2*scale)
    loft()

radius=param("spine_radius",3.4)
length=param("spine_length",7.5)
tip=param("spine_tip_radius",0.55)
rounding=param("spine_rounding",0.45)
top_z=param("top_spine_height",57.3)
second_z=param("second_spine_height",53.3)
seventh=param("seventh_spine_scale",0.7)
tail_z1=param("tail_spine_1_height",8.1)
tail_z2=param("tail_spine_2_height",8.7)
tail_x1=param("tail_spine_1_x",26)
tail_spacing=param("tail_spine_spacing",6)
positions=[(4,top_z,14),(15,second_z,32),(21,46,65),(23,38,82),(23.5,30,90),(22.7,22,95),(21,14,102),(tail_x1,tail_z1,35),(tail_x1+tail_spacing,tail_z2,20)]
side_inset=param("spine_side_inset",0.6)
pieces=[]
for i,(x,z,angle) in enumerate(positions):
    if 1<=i<=6:
        x-=side_inset
    size=seventh if i==6 else (1 if i<6 else .65)
    rr=radius*size
    ll=length*size
    with BuildPart() as bp:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
            with BuildLine():
                Polyline((0,0),(rr,0))
                Spline((rr,0),(rr*1.02,ll*.22),(rr*.77,ll*.60),(tip*size+rounding*size,ll*.91),(0,ll))
                Line((0,ll),(0,0))
            make_face()
        revolve(axis=Axis.Z)
    pieces.append(Pos(x,0,z)*Rot(0,angle,0)*bp.part)
spines=Compound(children=pieces)
spines.color=srgb("#24a84e")
publish("spines",spines,"九枚背刺与分开尾刺",material="pla")
fit("spines","dino",kind="fused",reason="背刺及尾刺根部融合进靠背与凹弧尾面")
